title: Quasihyperbolic domains are CAT(2)
summary: We prove that every proper subdomain of the Euclidean space equipped with its quasihyperbolic metric is CAT(2). The CAT property leads to a positive resolution of Väisälä's uniqueness, prolongation, quasihyperbolic convexity, and local geodesic conjectures on quasihyperbolic geodesics affirmatively on all dimensions, extending the two-dimensional results by Herron. The sectional curvature bound is optimal as demonstrated by the complement of two points in dimensions at least three.
